character: Fictional New Hampshire circuit introduced in Forza Motorsport (2023). A technical, tree-lined layout in the style of classic New England road courses; no individual corners have established community names.
notes: Community knowledge (no formal corner-name guide available). Character based on official Forza track-list description; no individual corners have established community names.

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.type: medium-speed corner off the front straight
corners.trap: Running wide compromises the run into the following section

corners.name: Turn 5
corners.technique: Commit with smooth steering, carry speed through the corner
corners.trap: Lifting unnecessarily costs momentum through the fast section

corners.name: Turn 9
corners.technique: Patient braking, low-speed precision, prioritise a clean exit
corners.trap: Carrying too much speed in and running out of track

corners.name: Final Corner
corners.technique: Late apex, clean exit is critical — feeds the front straight
corners.trap: Compromised exit costs time down the entire straight
